goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown, type operator ID 'teller1', type password 'password', click Sign On. Click 'Member Inquiry', type member number '100234' into the search value field, click Search, click 'Select'. On the member record page, click 'Update Member Information'. The required field labels are prefixed with an asterisk, e.g. '* E-mail', '* Phone', '* Mailing Address' -- use those exact label texts (without the trailing colon) as the 'name' argument for the type tool. These textboxes are pre-filled with the member's CURRENT values -- you do not need to read or know the current value, just type the new value directly into the field to replace it. Type 'ada.lovelace+v6@example.com' into '* E-mail'. Type '555-0144' into '* Phone'. Do NOT type into '* Mailing Address' -- leave it unchanged. Click 'Save Changes' to save for real (this is sandbox data, completing it for real is fine and required). After the save completes, extract the page's heading text (the value with role heading) as an output named update_confirmation. Then immediately call done referencing that output -- do not take any extra steps first.
